questions.question: On this day in 1975, who became King of Spain following the death of dictator Francisco Franco?
questions.explanation: Juan Carlos I was declared the monarch of Spain two days after Franco passed away, according to the succession laws set out by Franco.
questions.context:
On this day in 1975: Two days after the death of Francisco Franco, Juan Carlos I (pictured) was declared King of Spain according to the law of succession promulgated by Franco.
Francisco Franco (Leader of Spain from 1939 to 1975): Francisco Franco Bahamonde was a Spanish military general and the dictator of Spain from 1939 until his death in 1975. He had led the Nationalist forces in overthrowing the Second Spanish Republic during the Spanish Civil War from 1936 to 1939.

questions.question: Who co-directed the 2026 experimental documentary film You Can See Everything alongside Lance Oppenheim?
questions.explanation: You Can See Everything is a 2026 documentary co-directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim.
questions.context: You Can See Everything (2026 documentary film): You Can See Everything is a 2026 American experimental documentary film directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. It follows Elizabeth Holmes, the founder of the defunct health technology company Theranos, and her partner Billy Evans, who invited a film crew to document them beginning in the weeks before Holmes began serving a United States federal prison sentence for defrauding investors.

questions.question: Which English retired rugby union player, who earned the nickname 'Mad Dog', won the 2003 World Cup with England?
questions.explanation: Lewis Moody played for Leicester Tigers and Bath, won the World Cup with England in 2003, and was nicknamed 'Mad Dog'.
questions.context: Lewis Moody (British Lions & England international rugby union player (born 1978)): Lewis Walton Moody is an English retired rugby union player. He played for Leicester Tigers and Bath and was part of the 2003 World Cup winning side. Moody was chosen for the 2005 British & Irish Lions tour to New Zealand, being capped twice. He is known for the enthusiasm with which he played the game, his willingness to chase down opponents and his ability to compete for possession at restarts, which earned him the nickname "Mad Dog" from teammates and supporters.

questions.question: Which 2025 dystopian novel by Suzanne Collins acts as the second prequel to the main Hunger Games trilogy?
options: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
questions.explanation: Suzanne Collins released Sunrise on the Reaping in 2025 as the second prequel book following The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.
questions.context: Sunrise on the Reaping (2025 novel by Suzanne Collins): Sunrise on the Reaping is a 2025 dystopian novel written by American author Suzanne Collins and the second prequel novel to the original The Hunger Games trilogy, following The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes (2020).

questions.question: Mathematician Bernhard Riemann first proposed his famous hypothesis regarding the zeros of the zeta function in which year?
questions.explanation: Bernhard Riemann introduced the Riemann hypothesis in 1859, posing one of the most famous open problems in pure mathematics.
questions.context: Riemann hypothesis (Statement about zeros of the zeta function): In mathematics, the Riemann hypothesis asserts that the Riemann zeta function has its zeros only at the negative even integers and at complex numbers with real part. First posed in 1859 by Bernhard Riemann, it is considered by pure mathematicians to be one of the most important problems in the field. The result has importance in number theory because it implies bounds on the distribution of prime numbers.
